modules.name: GENRA Generative Sequencer
modules.description: Genre-aware generative sequencer: 8 drum voices, bass, melody and polyphonic pads with shared chord progressions

modules.name: GENRA Grid Editor
modules.description: Grid editor for GENRA: drum grid, piano roll and velocity lane for every track, docks next to GENRA

modules.name: ABLAUF Song Arranger
modules.description: Song arranger for GENRA: 128 named pattern places in 4 banks, a song list with bars, parts, track mutes and fills, one button per song part that turns the playing pattern into an intro, build, drop, break or outro

modules.name: MIX
modules.description: 4-track stereo mixer for GENRA's tracks: shelf EQ, pan, level, mute/solo, two send/return loops, ducking from the kick, width, drive

modules.name: GENRA FX
modules.description: Send effects for MIX: an 8-line FDN reverb (hall, room, plate, space, shimmer, freeze) and a tempo-synced tape delay, GENRA's tempo without cables

modules.name: STOTTER Performance FX
modules.description: DJ-style performance effects: 16 pads (stutter, halftime, reverse, tape stop, scratch, gates, echo out, freeze, bitcrush, rearrange) launched on the beat, isolator EQ with kills, DJ filter, MIDI

modules.name: SCHLAG Sample Drums
modules.description: Sample drum machine for GENRA's drum track, after the Polyend Play: 8 tracks with a WAV folder each, RANDOM rolls a sample per step from the folder, 4 knobs per track with 18 functions (tune, start/end, decay, filter, drive, bits, sends, repeat, chance, action), MIDI in, PRINT to ABLAUF

modules.name: JIANT DRUM-X
modules.description: The JIANT FM firmware's DRUM-X drum synth: 8 synthesized sounds with A/B morph, 9 kits, individual outputs, its kit of creatures drawn live

modules.name: GRUND
modules.description: Bass voice for GENRA's bass track: 10 models (upright, arco, finger, pick, slap, fretless, synth, reese, FM, 808), 4 amps, tone filter with envelope, drive, compressor, octaver, chorus, reverb, glide on SLIDE, accent, 30 presets by style

modules.name: GRUND FX
modules.description: Expander for GRUND (dock it on the right): compressor with sidechain, drive (tube, FET, fuzz, crush), 3-band EQ with high-pass, chorus, reverb, each with on/off and CV

modules.name: GENRA MONO
modules.description: Monophonic bass synth after the Moog Minitaur: two morphing oscillators, eight filter models (ladder, diode, MS-20, SEM, OTA), two ADSRs, LFO

modules.name: FUNKE
modules.description: Melody voice for GENRA's melody track: 8 models (Rhodes, organ, bell, marimba, pluck, square, saw lead, flute), the 8 filters of GENRA MONO, glide on SLIDE, accent, delayed vibrato, lo-fi, chorus, clocked echo, reverb

modules.name: SCHMELZ
modules.description: String machine in the spirit of the 70s/80s: morphing strings registration with octaves and ensemble, a polyphonic solo section (bass, e-piano, clavi, synth, bell), animate, phaser and reverb

modules.name: GENRA BOX Groovebox
modules.description: GENRA's generator with four voices in one module (DRUM-X, GENRA MONO, FUNKE, SCHMELZ): genre per track, NEW picks a preset of the track's genre, MUTATE, DUCK, NOTES / GATES / DRUMS and clock outputs

modules.name: ABLAUF MINI Song Parts
modules.description: Song parts on 16 pads for GENRA or GENRA BOX: ROOT, one button per part, re-roll / vary per track, MAKE SONG fills the pads with the genre's song form and plays it, MIDI export with markers
